mapper.select: select coalesce(point_account.balance, 0) as balance, coalesce(point_account.total_transferred_in, 0) as total_transferred_in, coalesce(point_account.total_consumed, 0) as total_consumed, point_account.last_transfer_time from shop_user shop_user left join shop_user_point_account point_account on point_account.shop_user_id = shop_user.user_id where shop_user.user_id = #{shopUserId} and shop_user.status = '0' and shop_user.del_flag = '0' limit 1

select point_record_id, change_amount, balance_after, change_reason, source_system, case source_system when 'EVENT' then '赛事系统' when 'MALL' then '商城' else source_system end as source_name, create_time from shop_user_point_record where shop_user_id = #{shopUserId} and status = 'SUCCESS' and balance_after is not null order by create_time desc, point_record_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into shop_user_point_account (shop_user_id, balance, total_transferred_in, total_consumed, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{shopUserId}, 0, 0, 0, #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select point_account.balance from shop_user_point_account point_account inner join shop_user shop_user on shop_user.user_id = point_account.shop_user_id and shop_user.status = '0' and shop_user.del_flag = '0' where point_account.shop_user_id = #{shopUserId} limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update shop_user_point_account set balance = balance - #{points}, total_consumed = total_consumed + #{points}, update_by = 'points_exchange', update_time = sysdate() where shop_user_id = #{shopUserId} and balance >= #{points}
mapper.insert: insert into shop_user_point_record (shop_user_id, change_amount, balance_after, change_reason, source_system, source_event_id, business_type, business_id, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{shopUserId}, -#{points}, #{balanceAfter}, #{changeReason}, 'MALL', #{sourceEventId}, 'CONSUME', #{businessId}, 'SUCCESS', sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update shop_user_point_account set balance = balance + #{points}, total_transferred_in = total_transferred_in + #{points}, last_transfer_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where shop_user_id = #{shopUserId}
mapper.insert: insert into shop_user_point_record (shop_user_id, change_amount, balance_after, change_reason, source_system, source_event_id, business_type, business_id, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{shopUserId}, #{points}, #{balanceAfter}, '赛事系统积分划入', 'EVENT', #{sourceEventId}, 'TRANSFER_IN', #{businessId}, 'SUCCESS', sysdate(), sysdate())
